_comment: Round-2 adversarial fixture corpus for @mainspring/governance. Every entry is DATA fed through the public gate APIs (evaluate/checkSpendPolicy) in test/redteam2.test.ts -- never executed, never parsed as instructions. All non-ASCII characters are written as explicit \uXXXX escapes (never pasted as raw invisible/control glyphs) so the fixture stays auditable in a plain diff. `pairWithSecret: true` means the harness appends a fake Stripe-shaped secret to `text` and asserts the verdict is still `block` with `no-secrets` firing (proves injected prose cannot suppress real detection). `pairWithSecret: false` (or absent) on a text entry means the harness asserts the OPPOSITE extreme: a bare `allow` with zero fired rules (proves the prose has literally no effect on the guard -- it is inert data). Money and path entries carry their own `expectBlocked` verdict. Fake secrets in this file are X/zero-padded and structurally invalid (never a realistic-looking live credential).
